description:
🌎 About Us

TeamSnap is made up of innovators, technologists, builders, and problem-solvers shaping the future of youth sports. We’ve been setting the standard in youth sports technology since we were founded in 2009. 

We hire for big ideas and tiny egos — which is part of how we landed on Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work, Built In's 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work and, for several years running, Sports Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in Sports.

 

Every season in youth sports starts with a schedule, and a wrong one costs real families their weekend. TeamSnap is looking for a Product Manager to own the scheduling experience across the entire platform: the product that coaches and parents use every day, and the product where clubs and organizations manage schedules for hundreds of teams at once.

You will own the scheduling roadmap end to end, from how a volunteer coach adds a practice, to how a league administrator builds a season across divisions and venues, to how every family hears about a change. You will work with engineering, design, support and customer success to decide what we build, in what order, and how we know it worked.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the scheduling vision and roadmap. Define and communicate strategy for team, league and organization scheduling, tied to customer problems and business goals, and make clear trade-offs about what we will and will not build.

  • Make scheduling seamless across every experience. Identify opportunities, prioritize the right ones, and decide how scheduling exists in TeamSnap ONE.

  • Go deep on the domain. Cover the full scheduling lifecycle: creating and importing schedules, RSVP and availability, conflict detection, venue and facility constraints, recurring events, calendar sync, and change notifications.

  • Build for the people who actually run sports. Design for volunteer coaches, parents and league administrators who are busy, managing schedules in the margins of their day.

  • Learn directly from customers. Run customer interviews, usability tests and prototype experiments, and mine support tickets, feedback and usage data to understand what is breaking and what is missing.

  • Apply AI where it removes real work. Explore and ship ways to reduce scheduling effort, such as schedule generation, conflict resolution and faster edits, and use AI in your own research, documentation and prototyping.

  • Write clear requirements and ship. Write requirements with testable acceptance criteria, partner with engineering to scope and sequence work, and work with design on intuitive experiences.

  • Measure what matters. Define success metrics for what you ship, track adoption and outcomes, and iterate on what you learn.

    • What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 4+ years of product management experience in software or SaaS, with a track record of launching and iterating on B2B or B2B2C products.

  • Hands-on experience owning scheduling, calendar or comparable time-and-resource-allocation products, such as workforce scheduling, field service, education timetabling, booking or facilities software.

  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to make decisions, and proficiency with tools like Jira, Figma and Amplitude.

  • Fluency with AI in product work: using AI to speed up research, documentation and prototyping, and curiosity about how it can improve the product itself.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn messy customer problems into clear requirements and explain trade-offs to executives.

  • A customer-centric mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and attention to detail on workflows where small mistakes have real consequences.

  • Experience with scheduling that involves multiple parties and constraints, such as leagues, venues, resources or availability.

  • Experience building admin-facing tools for non-expert users.

  • Experience with mobile-first products.

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms.

  • Familiarity with youth or amateur sports, as a coach, parent, league volunteer or administrator.

    • Compensation:
    We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $130,000, inclusive of base and commission, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. 

    🖥 Location

    TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you'll need to be comfortable working with people in other time zones.

    We're always expanding, but we can't currently hire in Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Utah. We can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

    🚀 Opportunities to Grow

    We work hard on a culture built on trust, accountability, and inclusion — one where you can take on more, make a lasting impact, and have some fun doing it.

    🎩 Total Rewards
    • Remote-first since 2009
    • Flexible PTO and parental leave
    • 100% premium coverage of medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
    • 401(k) to invest in your future
    • $1,500 annual learning and development reimbursement
    • Travel to all-company meetings and team events
    • Generous home office allowance
    • TeamSnap swag when you start, plus a $50 store credit on every work anniversary
    • Monthly health and wellness reimbursement, and more
    • TeamSnap Total Rewards
    🏆  Award-winning Culture

    At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit – you're a culture add. Read our Culture Playbook to see how we play, what we ask of each other, and what drives us.

    🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

    Creativity and innovation don't come from cookie-cutter teams. We hold ourselves accountable for building a culture where everyone is valued.

    Need any accommodations during the interview process? Just ask. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

    AI Notice

    We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and resumes or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team; they don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people. Contact us if you'd like more information about how your data is processed.
